title: Train the classifier
summary: Trains the classifier on the train part, keeps every epoch, and picks the best epoch on validation.
does: tools/train.py through the flow: the optimiser (adam or adamw, weight decay only with adamw), the schedule (constant or cosine, after warm-up epochs), a learning-rate scale for the backbone, the sampler, the loss weights and the measure that picks the kept epoch on validation. Every epoch's weights are kept, epoch 0 included, so the witness frames are drawn at every checkpoint. On the experiment route training and evaluation run in one GPU job (grid/experiment-driver.sbatch: 8 CPUs, 64 GB) whose wall time is hours.

inputs.name: model
inputs.what: A 2-D classifier built for split data.

outputs.name: checkpoint
outputs.what: The trained weights of every epoch and the kept one.

params.name: weight_decay
params.what: the weight decay, above 0 only with adamw; src/schwingnet/blocks.py sets no upper bound, 1 is the sandbox's cap

params.name: backbone_lr_scale
params.what: the backbone's learning rate over the head's, above 0 and at most 1

params.name: select
params.what: the validation measure that picks the kept epoch

params.name: epochs
params.what: epochs to train (the experiment route takes 1 to 200)

params.name: hours
params.what: the GPU job's wall time, at most 48 hours

nondeterminism: torch's deterministic kernels are asked for with warn_only, so a GPU run may differ in its last bits (tools/train.py).

generic.why: The trainer reads 2-D crops of the catalog (tools/train.py); volumes and clips would need a reader and a network of their own.

resolve: a trained {family} whose {rank}-D stem takes {sizes.C} channel(s) of {sizes.H} x {sizes.W}; head of {classes}

today.note: one GPU job a request, on the owner's word
